cd /workspace && cat > tmp/dev/t26a.py << 'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import run, hx
import ref, imgtool
from collections import Counter
rng = random.Random(1234)
seen=set(); fib=[]
while len(fib)<8192:
    L=rng.randint(0,16); a=ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128),L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L)); fib.append((a,L,rng.randint(0,4194302)))
q=[fib[i][0] for i in range(0,len(fib),40)][:200]+[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(50)]
ops=[['put',hx(a),l,h] for a,l,h in fib]+[['query',[hx(x) for x in q]],['save'],['load_saved',0],['image_query',[hx(x) for x in q]]]
t0=time.time(); resp=run({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}); t1=time.time()
print('native %.2fs'%(t1-t0))
r=resp['results'][0]; img=r['snapshots'][0]
print('rows',sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']),'cells',img['cells'],'dict',len(img['bitmaps']),'ni',len(img['nexthops']))
t0=time.time(); ok,reason,fib0=ref.validate_image(img,want_fib=True); t1=time.time()
print('py validate %.2fs -> %s %s fib %d'%(t1-t0,ok,reason,len(fib0) if fib0 else -1))
nodes=imgtool.find_nodes(img)
print('types',dict(Counter(n['type'] for n in nodes)),'nodes',len(nodes))
Q=ref.make_lpm(fib); Q2=ref.make_lpm(fib0)
print('live ok',r['answers'][:len(q)]==[Q(x) for x in q])
print('img ok',r['answers'][len(q):]==[Q2(x) for x in q])
PYEOF
